target_customer: Companies of all sizes that want internal short links (go/ links) and, later, AI workplace search
problem: Teams waste time finding and sharing internal URLs; go links such as go/metrics, long used inside Google and Yahoo, were unavailable as a product for other companies.
product_category: Productivity, internal short links and enterprise search

founders.name: Jorge Zamora
founders.background_notes: G2 spotlight: started as a designer and civil engineering CAD drafter, founder or founding member of four startups, got the idea at Yahoo. Education not stated.

competitors.name: Google internal go links
competitors.what: In house go/ link system used inside Google, not sold as a product
competitors.traction_then: Used by Google employees since the end of 2006 per a Trot.to history

technical_complexity.rationale: A redirect service with team namespaces, permissions and browser extensions is simple engineering; scale and security reviews came later.

defensibility.rationale: Once employees habitually use go/ links the link library creates lock in, but the concept is easy to copy and open source versions exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent sold an enterprise go links product in the sources found; GoLinks reports SOC 2 Type 2 and customers such as ServiceNow and Asana on its pages.

market_need_then: Large tech companies built go links in house for years, and Zamora saw at Yahoo that crucial internal tools had no commercial alternatives.

branding.name_origin: Named after the category it sells, go links; the company's own history traces go links to Google, Yahoo and NC State systems.
branding.domain_note: Uses golinks.io; GoLinks is a registered mark (shown as GoLinks with the registered symbol) and the company promotes a go links history page.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain productivity pitch: easy to remember short links, powered by AI

branding.brand_signature: go/ links as a category name, with GoSearch and GoProfiles extending the Go family
branding.community_and_virality: Content marketing around the history of go links; no fan community or merch found

brand_strength.rationale: The name is a category label that is easy to remember and spread across a Go product family, but it is descriptive and hard to own.

outcome_analysis: GoLinks took a small seed around YC, raised a 27M Series A led by Anthos Capital in late 2021 or early 2022, and now runs about 70 people. Its edge was founder insight from Yahoo plus a habit forming product, and it extended into GoSearch and GoProfiles in 2023 as AI search grew. No exit, layoffs or shutdown were found.
notes: Series A date conflicts: CB Insights says 2021-10-25, YC page says February 1 2022; the investor list comes from a Wikipedia draft and is partly unverified. A 150K seed in March 2019 appears only on Seedtable (single aggregator) and is unverified. Founding year 2016 from the company blog (SaaS released August 29 2016); other profiles say 2017 or 2019. The Google competitor source is dated 2020 but describes a 2006 system. Trotto exists but no source dated near the batch was found. GoLinks own timeline claims Yo links at Yahoo in 2012, unverified.
